L2@P0: Yu. A. Levitskaya E. M. Kreines Yu. Yu. Kochetkov

L4@P0: ITEP, MSU, Moscow, Russia
L5@P0: E-mails: kreines@itep.ru, shabat@mccme.ru
L6@P0: Abstract
L7@P0: In this work all the dessins d’enfant with no more than 4 edges are listed
L8@P0: and their Belyi pairs are computed. In order to enumerate all dessins the
L9@P0: technique of matrix model computations was used. The total number of dessins
L10@P0: is 134; among them 77 are spherical, 53 of genus 1 and 4 of genus 2. The
L11@P0: automorphism groups of all the dessins are also found.
L12@P0: Dessins are listed by the number of edges. Dessins with the same number of edges are ordered lexicographically by their lists of 0-valencies. The
L13@P0: corresponding matrix model for any list of 0-valencies is given and computed.
L14@P0: Complex matrix models for dessins with 1 – 3 edges are used. For the dessins
L15@P0: with 4 edges we use Hermitian matrix model, correlators for which are computed in [1].

L69@P2: 1 Introduction
L70@P2: Dessin d’enfant is a compact connected smooth oriented surface S
L71@P2: together with a graph Γ on it such that the complement S \Γ is homeomorphic to a disjoint union of open discs. The theory of Dessins
L72@P2: d’enfants was initiated by A. Grothendieck in [6, 5] and actively developed thereafter, see [7] and references therein. Dessins d’enfants became rather popular within the last decades; they provide a possibility
